intent: Implement explicit user LLM configuration and zero default LLM in evopilot-harness v4.2.4: remove every built-in or generated default provider, model, endpoint, profile, and credential assumption; require user-owned external Workspace configuration and live verification for LLM-required operations; preserve deterministic non-LLM operation; synchronize WorkBuddy installed runtime; and expose immutable Bundle handoff for EvoPilot read-only consumption.
objective: Ship a provider-neutral Harness release that never distributes the operator's GLM profile or borrows an Agent-host model, while preserving existing user configuration and making model readiness, WorkBuddy runtime binding, and Registry/Catalog/Bundle consumption explicit and verifiable.

include: Remove built-in and generated default provider, model, endpoint, profile, and credential assumptions
Require explicit user-owned external Workspace model configuration and a successful live doctor for LLM-required operations
Preserve existing human-maintained models.json byte-for-byte across initialization, install, upgrade, repair, and restart
Support user-selected profile and local credential binding with structured readiness and drift states
Keep deterministic non-LLM operations usable while model readiness is incomplete
Synchronize WorkBuddy expert, MCP entry, isolated npm runtime, and persistent external Workspace binding
Report Registry path, Organization Catalog digest, and immutable Bundle identity/digest for EvoPilot read-only consumption
Add deterministic tests, documentation, package checks, migration coverage, and candidate-package real WorkBuddy evidence
exclude: Shipping or generating the operator's GLM profile, API endpoint, or credential
Selecting any provider or model by default
Borrowing the WorkBuddy or other Agent-host conversation model
EvoPilot mutation of Harness producer state
Commit, push, tag, GitHub Release, npm publication, GHCR, container, cloud, or deployment actions

acceptance.criterion: Release contains no built-in or generated default LLM profile.
Release contains no default provider, model, endpoint, or credential assumption.
A fresh Workspace does not create a provider-specific models.json.
A missing model profile reports NOT_CONFIGURED.
A profile without an available credential reports CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED.
Configuration and credential without a current doctor receipt report CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED.
Only a successful live doctor produces CONFIGURED_AND_VERIFIED.
Doctor transport or authentication failure never falls back or reports readiness.
Configuration drift invalidates the verification receipt.
Advisor and Proposal Review bind the same explicit Workspace model configuration digest.
Explicit profile and Workspace configuration follow one provider-neutral precedence contract with no fallback.
Existing human-maintained models.json remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Legacy configuration migration is idempotent, auditable, and never overwrites an external target.
CLI, MCP, Session, logs, receipts, and acceptance evidence expose no credential.
Deterministic non-LLM operations remain usable while LLM readiness is incomplete.
LLM-required Advisor and Proposal Review stop accurately until verification succeeds.
WorkBuddy install, upgrade, and repair synchronize the expert, MCP entry, isolated npm runtime, and preserve unrelated state.
WorkBuddy restart preserves one user-selected external Workspace and reports Product, Expert, Core, and MCP version 4.2.4.
The exact candidate npm package completes explicit LLM configuration, doctor, DOCX evidence, and Proposal human gates in real WorkBuddy without source-checkout resolution.
Publication reports Registry path, Organization Catalog digest, immutable Bundle identity and digest for EvoPilot read-only binding without mutation.
